A personal VPN client with no advertising or analytics. Connection profiles are encrypted using Android Keystore. Android backups are disabled.

Wayveil uses Android VPN access to send network traffic selected by your routing mode through an encrypted connection to the server in your profile. That server processes your traffic and can observe your source IP address, connection times, destination addresses and DNS requests.

Cloudflare receives DNS queries and HTTPS connection checks to resolve destinations and check internet access. Wayveil does not sell or use VPN data for advertising or analytics.

Activating sends a random installation ID, device model and access credentials to ChromVoid at link.chromvoid.com. The service stores this registration and connection reports to provide VPN access and enforce device limits. Removing access revokes this installation; it does not erase the stored server record.
